title: Native derived tensor adjoints with invertible forgetful unit mate
statement:
Let $k_0$ be a finite field, $\ell$ a prime distinct from its characteristic,
$X$ a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme, and $\mathcal D=D(\operatorname{ProEtaleWeilSheaf}(k_0,\ell,X))$.
Put $F=\operatorname{nativeForget}$ and let $\mathcal E$ be the ordinary derived category of
adic sheaves on the geometric fibre. Fix native closed Hom models $M$ and a natural
isomorphism $\eta:M.weilHom\,F\simeq(F^{op}\times F)M.ordinaryHom$ satisfying
NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models]. Fix an ordinary
closed structure $S$ [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], a symmetry $\beta$, an equality
of $S.monoidal$ with the canonical derived module monoidal structure, and
NativeOrdinaryTensorModels for $S,\beta$ relative to $M.ordinaryRepresentatives$.
There exist a bifunctor $T:\mathcal D\times\mathcal D\to\mathcal D$ and adjunctions
$a_K:T(-,K)\dashv M.weilHom(K,-)$ such that for every $f:K'\to K$ and $L$,
$$T(M.weilHom(f,1_L),1_{K'})\,\operatorname{counit}(a_{K'})_L
 =T(1_{M.weilHom(K,L)},f)\,\operatorname{counit}(a_K)_L.$$
There is a natural isomorphism $\tau:TF\simeq(F\times F)S.tensor$ satisfying
$$\tau^{-1}_{A,K}=\operatorname{uncurry}_S
 (F(\operatorname{unit}(a_K)_A)\,\eta_{K,T(A,K)})$$
for all $A,K$. Composition is written in Lean order. No monoidal constraints on
$\mathcal D$, coefficient-unit identifications or symmetry on $T$ are asserted.

proof.text: For each K use native_weil_hom_isRightAdjoint. Choose its left adjoint, determined up to its unique compatible isomorphism. Curry M.weilHom and define maps in the tensor parameter by inverse conjugateEquiv. Its identity and composition laws give a functor-valued family; uncurrying after swapping factors gives T. Transport the pointwise adjunctions across the identity-component slice isomorphisms. The mate counit equation gives the required parameter-natural counits; its unit equation gives parameter-natural units. All these categorical constructions are proved in tensor_of_pointwise_adjoints.

Define the ordinary-to-forgotten-tensor arrow by uncurrying the forgotten native unit followed by η. Prove naturality in A using native unit naturality, η target naturality and ordinary inverse-adjunction naturality. Prove naturality in K using the parameter-unit equation from step 1, η source naturality and S.evaluation_naturality. Functoriality combines the two squares into naturality for arbitrary product morphisms. This explicit proof defines unitMate.

Apply native_weil_unit_mate_isIso to each component of unitMate. NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app upgrades this natural transformation to a natural isomorphism. Its inverse is τ; by construction τ.inv has exactly the required component formula.

lean.statement:
theorem native_weil_tensor_adjoints
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    (M : NativeClosedHomModels k₀ l X)
    (η : M.weilHom ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
      (nativeForget k₀ l X).op.prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ M.ordinaryHom)
    (hη : NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X)
      (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
      M.weilHom M.ordinaryHom M.weilRepresentatives M.ordinaryRepresentatives
      (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) η)
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure M.ordinaryHom)
    (β : @SymmetricCategory _ _ S.monoidal)
    (hmonoidal : S.monoidal = (inferInstance : MonoidalCategory
      (DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber))))
    (hS : NativeOrdinaryTensorModels l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber
      M.ordinaryHom M.ordinaryRepresentatives S β) :
    ∃ T : (DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X)) ×
      DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X),
    ∃ a : ∀ K : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X),
      Prod.sectL _ K ⋙ T ⊣ Prod.sectR (op K) _ ⋙ M.weilHom,
      (∀ (K K' L : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X)) (f : K' ⟶ K),
        T.map (X := (M.weilHom.obj (op K, L), K'))
            (Y := (M.weilHom.obj (op K', L), K'))
            (M.weilHom.map (X := (op K, L)) (Y := (op K', L)) (f.op, 𝟙 L), 𝟙 K') ≫
              (a K').counit.app L =
          T.map (X := (M.weilHom.obj (op K, L), K'))
            (Y := (M.weilHom.obj (op K, L), K))
            (𝟙 (M.weilHom.obj (op K, L)), f) ≫ (a K).counit.app L) ∧
      ∃ τ : T ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
        (nativeForget k₀ l X).prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ S.tensor,
      ∀ A K : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X),
        τ.inv.app (A, K) =
          (S.transpose ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj A) ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj K)
            ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj (T.obj (A, K)))).symm
              ((nativeForget k₀ l X).map ((a K).unit.app A) ≫
                η.hom.app (op K, T.obj (A, K)))
